name: Flat Glass Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Flat Glass Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of glass products in the People's Republic of China, the rest of Asia, Europe, North America, and internationally. It operates through PV Glass, Household Glass, Architectural Glass, Float Glass, Mining Products, Electricity Generation Revenue, and Other Business segments. The company is also involved in the mining operations and sale of quartzite ores; investment, construction, operation, and maintenance of energy power plants; and sale and installation of natural gas pipelines.
